title: Universal dualities for Wilson loops in lattice Yang-Mills
summary: We identify a universal finite-$N$ structure underlying Wilson loop expectations in lattice Yang--Mills, in any dimension $d\geq 2$, for gauge group $\mathrm{U}(N)$, and for arbitrary smooth central plaquette actions. The starting point is a state-sum expansion in plaquette labels by irreducible representations, in which each term factorizes into an action-dependent spectral weight and an action-independent topological coefficient.
